mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.5% for two months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both increasing) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of sustained industrial production growth above 0.5% monthly, supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate capacity utilization rises, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO growth signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening residential construction and consumer confidence, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for two months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a dual stress on the labor market and monetary policy, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and FEDFUNDS rising) fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), consumer spending and business investment surge, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% quarterly, or the Rank IC for the GDPC1 growth signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
